One important change

Nemuro Hanamaru’s Ginza branch closed on 23 September 2026. The plan uses its KITTE Marunouchi branch instead.

The food logic

Only distinct food types from the second research sheet were added. Similar ramen, sushi, pizza, burger and okonomiyaki suggestions were left out.
